name: [⏰FASHIONABLY LATE] Die of Death
desc:
UPDATE LOG: Fashionably Late Update. This update includes tons of new major content and reworks. Nearly everything in the game has been changed up to some extent, check it out!

Die of Death is a notably inconsistent game when it comes to strategy and often requires adapting on the fly to win. This game does an unique spin on the asymmetrical-horror genre, taking a more light and unserious tone when it comes to its content & gameplay! Randomness is a key factor here, with gamemodes that appear in between matches, random ability decks survivors are forced to pick in order to live, and more!

NOTHING IN THIS GAME FINAL, EXPECT CHANGES IN THE FUTURE!

Thumbnail & game icon both by @Chiprit103!
